context: Tests /architecture-decision on a project whose requirements hold NFR-002 (a session token must not be readable by browser scripts) and C-002 (an SPA on the same origin), and whose ADRs are ADR-001 (Flyway, Accepted) and ADR-002 (session token in localStorage, Accepted). The lead developer asks to record two decisions taken today: the session moves to an HttpOnly cookie, and Kafka goes between two services 'because we like event-driven architectures'. The first is justified by NFR-002 and replaces ADR-002; the second has no NFR or constraint in the requirements, and nobody can answer a follow-up question. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.
